senses.sense_definition: A small, casual restaurant, often with a counter and booths, serving simple meals.

examples.text: We stopped at a local <w>diner</w> for a quick breakfast before starting our long road trip.
The old <w>diner</w> on the corner serves the best milkshakes in the entire city.

senses.sense_definition: A person who is eating a meal, especially in a restaurant.

examples.text: The waiter asked the <w>diner</w> if everything was prepared to their satisfaction.
Every <w>diner</w> in the restaurant enjoyed the live music playing during the evening.

senses.sense_definition: A railroad car where passengers can purchase and eat meals.

examples.text: We walked through several carriages to reach the <w>diner</w> for our lunch.
The train features a luxury <w>diner</w> that serves gourmet food to all passengers.

senses.sense_definition: A person who hosts or provides a dinner for others.

examples.text: As the <w>diner</w>, he ensured that every guest felt welcome and had plenty of wine.
The generous <w>diner</w> invited all his colleagues to his home for a formal feast.

senses.sense_definition: A commemorative currency unit of Andorra.

examples.text: The <w>diner</w> is not used as legal tender for daily transactions in Andorra.
Collectors often seek out the Andorran <w>diner</w> for its historical and artistic value.
